# FuckCorpo

> Satirical PWA that calculates money earned during bathroom breaks at work. "Capitalist Satire" aesthetic: Wall Street visual language turned pro-worker. No backend; all state is client-side.

Generated: 2026-07-28 | commit 34e0f62

## Current verified state

- Two implementations of the same product live in this repo.
- React SPA (`src/`, React 19 + Vite 7) is the reference and live app. No test suite. Storage: `localStorage` key `fuckcorpo_data`.
- Flutter app (`app/`, Riverpod 3 + go_router 17 + fl_chart 1) has local MVP parity. Not released. Storage: `shared_preferences` key `fuckcorpo_state_v1`.
- Flutter: `flutter analyze` clean, 30 test files / 269 tests passing, `flutter build web` succeeds, Android release APK builds and installs on emulator (debug-signed).
- A one-shot v0 bridge migrates the React payload into Flutter v1 and never writes or deletes `fuckcorpo_data`.
- Overall cutover verdict: NOT READY, no-go. See `docs/migration/release_readiness.md`.

## Key docs

- CODE_MAP.md: feature-oriented file map for both apps

- docs/migration/release_readiness.md: verified evidence and open blockers
- docs/migration/cutover_plan.md: execution plan and go/no-go checklist
- docs/migration/deviations.md: deliberate divergences from React
- docs/ai/: memory, tasks, roadmap, decisions, architecture
- docs/audit/: codebase audit findings

## Commands

Flutter, run from `app/`:
- `flutter analyze`
- `flutter test --reporter compact --concurrency=1` (269 tests)
- `flutter build web` (output `app/build/web`)
- `flutter build apk --release` (currently debug-signed)

React, run from the repo root:
- `npm run dev`
- `npm run build`
- `npm run preview`
- `npm run lint`

No CI exists for either app.

## Remaining gates

Blockers:
- B1: no staging deployment. The Vercel project does not exist, so PWA installability, offline load, service-worker update, and Lighthouse are unverified.
- B2: migration never run against a copy of a genuine pre-existing user profile.
- B5: no release keystore, no signed app bundle, nothing on a Play track.
- B6: iOS has never been built; Windows host cannot produce an IPA, and no written defer decision exists.

Non-blocking, resolve or waive in writing:
- N1: domain and data coverage (>= 90%) never measured.
- N2: analyze and test do not run in CI.
- N5: Android QA is emulator-only, no physical device run.

Cutover also requires the section 8 go/no-go checklist in the cutover plan to be fully checked plus explicit written owner approval.

## Constraints

- Do not modify React source while it remains the live reference.
- Never write or delete the `fuckcorpo_data` key.
- Brand voice: irreverent, pro-worker, corporate/financial language used satirically.
